title: Anthropic Localizes Claude Pricing in India with Rupee Billing
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Anthropic has reportedly begun rolling out localized Indian Rupee (INR) subscription plans for Claude Pro, Max, and Team tiers in India, its second-largest market.
body:
Anthropic has begun offering Claude’s subscription plans in Indian rupees, marking its first localized pricing rollout for the country that ranks as the model’s second‑largest market after the United States. Users in India now see Claude Pro priced at ₹2,000 per month when billed annually, Claude Max at ₹11,999, and Team plans at ₹2,399 per seat, with the amounts already inclusive of local taxes. While the rupee denominations appear on the web and mobile interfaces, payments still rely on credit cards or Apple / Google app‑store billing; support for India’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has not yet been added.

The move directly addresses a long‑standing pain point for Indian developers and researchers who previously faced currency‑conversion fees and the mental overhead of dollar‑based pricing. By presenting costs in the local currency and bundling taxes, Anthropic lowers the barrier to converting the region’s substantial developer base into paying customers. This aligns with the company’s broader India strategy—evidenced by a new Bengaluru office, leadership appointments, and partnerships with major IT services firms—while also responding to competitive pressures from rivals such as OpenAI, which already offers UPI‑enabled rupee pricing for ChatGPT. For AI practitioners, the change simplifies budgeting and could accelerate adoption of Claude’s capabilities in academic projects, startups, and enterprise pilots across the subcontinent.
